name: smwgraphics-kirby-super-star-bubbly-clouds
title: Kirby Super Star - Bubbly Clouds
description:
This now includes a MWL (Level) file since it's a complicated BG. ;)

This is the Background off of the Bubbly Clouds 3 stage from "Kirby Superstar."
It uses BG1, FG1, FG2, and just 12 tiles of FG3, FG3 can still be used, nothing really important is gone, all the land is still usable.
Palette, Map16 page, now a MWL file, and all ExGFX files included of course, credit not necessary, you can though. :)
